newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends lower against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends lower against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended lower at 43.7350/7450 to the doller in interbank trading against the previous at 43.6500/7450 on Wednesday, dealers said.

The taka recovered after opening at 43.7450/7490 on lower demand for dollar as most international markets were closed for the weekend. Dealers said interbank call money rates ended lower at 8.0-12 percent against 30-40 percent at the close of trading last Wednesday when they shot up in a pre-Eid demand for funds.
They said the call rates fell on Sunday on lower demand and release of some 700 million taka following maturity of BSRS (Bangladesh Shilpa Rin Sangstha) bonds.
